title: Slay the Spire 2 just got its first new character, a rapid-fire mode, and its hardest challenge yet
author: editor@pcgamesn.com
contents:
A new Slay the Spire 2 update adds new character The Fool to the roguelike deckbuilder's beta branch, alongside Blitz and Dread game modes.

Read the full story on PCGamesN: Slay the Spire 2 just got its first new character, a rapid-fire mode, and its hardest challenge yet
